dataset: Small curated factual USDA crop-salinity reference subset
source_attribution: USDA Agricultural Research Service, U.S. Salinity Laboratory, Fiber, Grain and Special Crops, accessed 29 October 2026. Endpoint identification cross-checked in FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 61, Annex 1.
rights_note: Small factual numerical extraction, not reproduction of the full table, slopes, images or source prose. No new CC licence asserted for the source publication. ARS describes official-duty US Government authorship as public-domain in the United States; third-party publication assets are not assumed to share that status.
limitations: Guidelines for relative terrestrial tolerance; climate, soil, management, growth stage and cultivars change responses.
The salinity composition is important; chloride-dominated reference conditions do not establish sulfate or perchlorate tolerance.
Gypsum changes the relation of saturated-extract EC to plant-experienced osmotic conditions; do not apply a universal correction to Mars.
Threshold alone does not support calculation of yield above threshold; slopes deliberately omitted.
Phoenix dilute WCL EC has a different extraction protocol; no direct threshold ranking or subtraction.
No numeric Ca/Mg/Na/Cl/SO4 or perchlorate toxicity limits are provided.

excluded_method_exceptions.method: Electrical conductivity of soil water while paddy plants are submerged; flooded-growing-condition exception, NOT standard ECe
excluded_method_exceptions.specific_caution: Less tolerant during seedling stage. Do not represent as a standard saturated-paste ECe threshold.
